description: This is a test class for InvalidOptionException, a custom exception class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.thingsearch.exceptions package. The file contains unit tests verifying immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, error code correctness, copying, and getter methods for the InvalidOptionException class.

classes.name: InvalidOptionExceptionTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the InvalidOptionException class, verifying immutability, JSON serialization, creation, copying, and getter methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the InvalidOptionException class instances are immutable.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method of the exception returns the expected JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creation of InvalidOptionException from a known valid JSON object.

methods.name: checkErrorCodeWorks
methods.description: Verifies that the error code parsing via GlobalErrorRegistry returns the correct exception instance.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception via builder and verifies equality.

methods.name: checkGetters
methods.description: Verifies that getter methods return correct values, matching the expected message, status code, and description.
